messages:
Maria Vega: Heads-up — billing just routed an anomaly alert for NETWORK_EGRESS on several eu-west1 projects. Dashboard shows ~2.3TB/day extra egress starting 2026-03-12. 
Ashwin Patel: On it. Which project? any alert id?
Maria Vega: alert referenced project: redwood-models-eu, but cost spread across model-artifacts and logs buckets. Billing window: last 72h. 
infra-bot: [alert] Billing anomaly detected: NETWORK_EGRESS spike (310%) for project redwood-models-eu at 2026-03-12T03:14Z. Ticket created: INF-2345.
Ashwin Patel: Querying billing export now. Running a quick BigQuery to break down egress by SKU and destination region. Snippet I ran: ```
SELECT
  sku.description AS sku,
  SUM(cost) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(usage_amount) AS bytes
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE DATE(_PARTITIONTIME) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
  AND LOWER(sku.description) LIKE '%egress%'
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
```
Noah Kim: I checked storage buckets — there was a nightly mirror job that started re-syncing after a failed run. Looks like `redwood-eu-logs` has a replication/lifecycle rule copying full compressed bundles to `redwood-archive-us` (us-east1) when the nightly marker file is missing. The failed run on 03/11 triggered a full catch-up on 03/12. 
Ashwin Patel: Can you paste the lifecycle/replication rule?
Noah Kim: Here's the relevant chunk from the bucket config: ```
{
  "lifecycle": {
    "rule": [
      {
        "action": { "type": "SetStorageClass", "storageClass": "NEARLINE" },
        "condition": { "age": 1, "matchesPrefix": ["logs/daily/"] }
      },
      {
        "action": { "type": "CopyTo", "destination": "projects/redwood/locations/us-east1/buckets/redwood-archive-us" },
        "condition": { "matchesPrefix": ["logs/daily/"], "isLive": true }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
Maria Vega: Oof — CopyTo triggers cross-region egress for every object moved. How much data did the re-sync move?
Ashwin Patel: From the billing export the `redwood-models-eu` project shows ~2.3TB/day egress to US over the spike window, cost ~ $2.7k/day. Finance projection if continuous is ~ $81k/month (rough estimate, includes NAT & inter-region transfer).
Finance Team: Confirmed — we saw a sudden $8.1k charge for the 3-day window; unclear whether part of that is networking vs storage ops. Need a breakdown for chargeback.
Noah Kim: The problem: the nightly job lost its marker file due to a transient permission error on 03/11, job re-enqueued and started doing full copy of the backlog (~7 days worth). Replication logic doesn't checkpoint per-object.
SRE Ops: Risk assessment — turning off replication will stop further egress but could leave backups incomplete for a week. Need to weigh cost vs compliance for retained archive copies. Any SLA or legal requirement?
Maria Vega: For these logs we only need a 7-day redundant copy for warm backups. We can turn off cross-region copy for the backlog and retain only the last 48h replicated. Also need to patch the job to resume incremental only.
Ashwin Patel: Proposed mitigations: 1) Pause lifecycle CopyTo rule immediately (gsutil command below). 2) Reconfigure job to use prefix filters and checkpointing. 3) Run targeted backfill for critical prefixes only. Commands I'm about to run: ```
# disable rule (preview)
gsutil lifecycle get gs://redwood-eu-logs > lifecycle.json
# edit lifecycle.json to remove CopyTo rule
gsutil lifecycle set lifecycle.json gs://redwood-eu-logs
```
SRE Ops: We'll also add a network egress budget alert for the project and add a per-bucket quota to avoid runaway syncs.
billing-bot: Created cost-report: `reports/INF-2345-egress-breakdown.csv` (attached to ticket).
Finance Team: Please provide expected delta if we pause replication now vs resume selective backfill. We need numbers for this week's invoice.
Ashwin Patel: Quick calc: stopping replication now saves ~2.3TB/day => ~ $2.7k/day. Selective backfill for 48h of critical prefixes (~120GB) adds ~ $140 egress. So net immediate savings ~ $2.6k/day.
Noah Kim: I'll implement a prefix filter to only copy `logs/critical/` and exclude `logs/debug/` and `logs/metrics/` and kick off a small test (1GB) to validate transfer accounting.
Maria Vega: Action items: 1) Noah pause CopyTo rule (ETA 15m). 2) Ashwin run BQ export with SKU-level split and attach to INF-2345 (ETA 1h). 3) SRE Ops add egress guardrails and alerting (ETA 2h). 4) Finance reconcile the interim charge (Finance Team).
SRE Ops: Noted — will not pause until Maria signs off because of retention policy. Maria Vega: I sign off for logs; do not touch model artifact replication yet.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-2345 updated: "Paused cross-region copy for redwood-eu-logs (pending audit)."
billing-bot: Uploaded preliminary chargeback breakdown to INF-2345.
Ashwin Patel: I'll also add a regression test to the pipeline so a missing marker file doesn't trigger full resync — we should always checkpoint per-object.
Maria Vega: Thanks team. Let's reconvene in 2 hours in this thread with the updated numbers and confirm roll-forward plan. :thumbsup:
